key.name: sidebar-default-mode
key.description: Whether to always collapse the sidebar on startup or remember the last state.

key.name: hide-adult-content
key.summary: Hide adult content in search results

key.name: hide-unreleased
key.summary: Hide movies and shows that have not premiered yet from the watchlist

key.name: hide-shows-no-upcoming-episodes
key.summary: Hide TV Shows with No Upcoming Episodes
key.description: Hide TV shows you've caught up on when no new episode is scheduled within the next few days.

key.name: hide-shows-upcoming-window
key.description: Number of days to look ahead for upcoming episodes. Only used when "Hide TV Shows with No Upcoming Episodes" is enabled.

key.name: diary-view-mode
key.description: Whether diary days show poster rows or a compact list

key.name: show-stats
key.summary: Show the stats section on the watchlist page

key.name: tmdb-api-key
key.description: API key for The Movie Database (TMDB). Used to fetch movie/show metadata.

key.name: onboarding-completed
key.description: Whether the user has completed the first-run setup wizard.

key.name: metadata-cache-ttl
key.description: How long (in seconds) to cache TMDB metadata before re-fetching. Default is 3600 (1 hour).

key.name: streaming-region
key.description: ISO-3166-1 country code used to look up where titles can be streamed. 'auto' detects the region from the system locale.

key.name: show-streaming-availability
key.description: Whether to show where movies and TV shows can be streamed, rented, or bought on the detail page.

key.name: content-filter-mode
key.description: Last used content filter mode: 'all', 'movies', or 'shows'. Restored on startup only when remember-content-filter is enabled.

key.name: remember-content-filter
key.description: Restore the last ALL/Movies/Shows content filter on startup instead of resetting to ALL.

key.name: swap-sections
key.summary: Swap Movies and TV Shows sections
key.description: List TV Shows before Movies on the watchlist, search and history pages. Applies after automatic restart.

key.name: american-date-format
key.description: Show the month before the day (Aug 12 instead of 12 Aug).

key.name: airing-notifications
key.description: Send a desktop notification when media on the watchlist airs or releases.

key.name: notification-scope
key.description: 'all' notifies the whole watchlist except muted media; 'selected' notifies only media picked on their detail page.

key.name: notifications-last-check
key.description: Unix timestamp of the last completed airing check; 0 means never.

key.name: sync-enabled
key.description: Master switch for cloud synchronization.

key.name: sync-auto
key.description: Sync in the background on a schedule. When off, manual syncing via "Sync Now" still works.

key.name: sync-tmdb-enabled
key.description: Sync watchlist and ratings with TMDB.

key.name: sync-simkl-enabled
key.description: Sync watchlist, watched, ratings, and collection with Simkl.

key.name: sync-letterboxd-enabled
key.description: Sync watchlist and ratings with Letterboxd. May break without notice.

key.name: sync-last-sync
key.description: Unix timestamp of the last completed cloud sync; 0 means never.

key.name: sync-interval-minutes
key.description: How often to sync with enabled backends, in minutes.
